title: Mahjong Slide Pairs
description: Slide entire rows and columns of crisp Mahjong tiles so identical pieces bump together and vanish—a fresh Sichuan-style logic twist that hooks players fast.
controls: Drag any tile horizontally or vertically to slide its line and align two matching Mahjong tiles side by side.

zh-CN.title: 麻将挪对对
zh-CN.description: 抖音微信超火麻将挪对对：整行整列丝滑推动麻将牌，让相同花色贴在一起瞬间消除，越玩越烧脑越上头！
zh-CN.controls: 上下左右拖动麻将牌带动整排移动，让两张相同麻将紧挨碰对即可消除通关。
